title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: Facilitator AI notes for in-person meetings
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout dates, licensing, default availability and control instructions are supported by the supplied notice and Microsoft documentation. It accurately distinguishes the Android roadmap plans from Learn's preview guidance and reports the differences between the sources.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans Facilitator notes for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Android.
claims.quote: the Facilitator agent assists you with notes, decisions and actions for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Android.

claims.claim: Facilitator is an AI agent that takes notes in scheduled Teams meetings.
claims.quote: Facilitator is an AI-powered agent in Teams that can automatically take notes of the conversations that happen during a meeting, provide key highlights, and answer prompts in the meeting chat.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes inviting Facilitator with one tap on the room console.
claims.quote: Simply invite Facilitator with one tap of the room console.

claims.claim: After the meeting, participants with access can view and edit notes through the meeting recap in the meeting chat on Teams desktop.
claims.quote: After the meeting, notes can be viewed and edited by participants with access via the meeting recap in the meeting chat on the Teams desktop client.

claims.claim: Notes are deleted automatically if no participant was added through Access notes during the session.
claims.quote: If no participant was added during the note-taking session via Access notes, notes are deleted automatically.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes notes as available via meeting recap when shared and deleted if nobody is selected.
claims.quote: Meeting notes appear on the front of room display or touch board, are available via meeting recap when shared, and deleted if no one selected.

claims.claim: Learn calls the save step Save notes, unlike the notice's Access notes label.
claims.quote: At the end of the session, select Save notes and ensure participants' names are added in the dialog pop-up so they can access the notes and transcript later on their personal devices.

claims.claim: Learn tells users to add participants' names in the Save notes dialog so they can access the notes later.
claims.quote: ensure participants' names are added in the dialog pop-up so they can access the notes and transcript later on their personal devices.

claims.claim: Learn says unsaved notes are deleted after the session ends.
claims.quote: Unsaved notes are deleted after the session ends.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Scope; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Learn gives Pro Management portal > Rooms > room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen as the room note-taking control.
claims.quote: In Pro Management portal, select Rooms from the left navigation > select your desired room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.

claims.claim: No Microsoft Learn API or automation is documented for the Pro Management portal Take notes setting as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: "Show Take notes button on the home screen" API; Teams Rooms Pro Management "Show Take notes" API PowerShell Graph; Teams module "Take notes" "Rooms". Read Facilitator in Microsoft Teams Rooms and returned API excerpts; no operation sets this control.

claims.claim: The general meeting transcription setting is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription.
claims.quote:
go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one.
Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowTranscription $true enables transcription in the specified meeting policy.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowTranscription $true

claims.claim: Learn links the general meeting transcription policy but does not state which policy a room resource account's in-person Facilitator notes use.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator in person Teams Rooms resource account which meeting transcription policy. Read Facilitator in Microsoft Teams Rooms, Manage transcription and captions, and Teams Rooms/Copilot search excerpts; none identifies a policy specifically for these in-person sessions.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no admin UI path for the Teams IsLoopEnabled setting.
claims.quote: Searched: Loop IsLoopEnabled IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled admin center UI settings. Read Admin policies for Loop components and Loop workspaces: the admin-center switch is for Loop workspaces; Teams IsLoopEnabled is documented through SharePoint PowerShell, not an admin UI.

claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true enables Loop components in Teams.
claims.quote: To enable Loop components in Teams, run Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true.

claims.claim: IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled is a tenant-wide property.
claims.quote: It applies to the entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.claim: Learn's Pro Management portal setup step does not name a platform, leaving Android applicability unconfirmed in that step.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Pro Management "Show Take notes" API PowerShell Graph; Facilitator in person Teams Rooms resource account which meeting transcription policy. Read Facilitator in Microsoft Teams Rooms: Step 4 names no platform; its FAQ projects Android for a future release.

claims.claim: MC1307888 asks administrators to verify that IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled is enabled.
claims.quote: Verify Loop components are enabled:- IsLoopEnabled- IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled

claims.claim: IsLoopEnabled applies to the entire tenant rather than individual users.
claims.quote: This property controls Loop component creation and integration in Microsoft Teams. It applies to the entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.claim: IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled does not apply to collaborative meeting notes in Teams New Calendar.
claims.quote: The SharePoint organization property doesn't apply to collaborative meeting notes in Teams New Calendar
